gen-righteous-gf-strait: Strait reads friendly and current, with big round lowercase bowls, while Righteous up top bends thin steel rod into every letter. Paragraph after paragraph, that sans keeps going without tiring.
gen-righteous-gf-truculenta: Righteous fills the line with commanding bowls, like thin steel rod bent into shape, while Truculenta packs in a compact line. Showy display up top, a tidy sans below.
gen-righteous-gf-winky-rough: One marker tip seems to trace Righteous, whose bowls fill the line, while Winky Rough nearly matches capital height. Righteous earns its keep when it runs big and short.
gen-righteous-outfit: Righteous fills the line with bowls, like thin steel rod bent into letters, while Outfit finishes its curves before they close. The standout is the gap between loud display and a quieter sans.
gen-silkscreen-gf-alegreya-sans-sc: Spaghetti lines, lots of breathing room: pure lo-fi. Silkscreen is best at rope-like stems; Alegreya Sans SC, a plain sans, at its open, welcoming gap in the c.
gen-silkscreen-gf-almarai: Retro and lo-fi, Silkscreen lays spaghetti-like letters out with space you can nearly feel. And Almarai, a sans with a line that never swells, keeps reading smooth across a whole page.
gen-silkscreen-gf-anta: Lo-fi from the first letter, Silkscreen leaves space around everything. Anta, a plain sans with gaping mouths on the e, keeps a wire-bent sign look that stays steady all the way down a column.
gen-silkscreen-gf-ar-one-sans: AR One Sans reads contemporary, with brush ends lifting away before each curve closes. But Silkscreen does constant-width, bent-pipe strokes best, while the sans does those lifted brush ends best.
gen-silkscreen-gf-asta-sans: Asta Sans keeps tubelike lines and an e that never blots. The standout quality is mood: retro, lo-fi Silkscreen sets the tone, and the plain sans keeps everything legible.
gen-silkscreen-gf-bai-jamjuree: Bai Jamjuree reads light and approachable, its round letters never pinched. Silkscreen brings the lo-fi, retro spacing up top, and this plain sans keeps its strokes free of modulation below.
